# SYMBIOSIS

> Research framework for voluntary, reversible and pluralistic cognitive symbiosis between humans and artificial intelligence. The current operational research level is SYMBIOSIS-Zero, a pre-pilot framework using conventional interfaces. It is not experimentally validated, not preregistered, and does not authorize participant recruitment.

SYMBIOSIS asks whether a human and an AI can temporarily form a cooperative cognitive system that outperforms either alone while preserving human autonomy, agency, integrity, transparency and the capacity to separate. Its organizing cycle is "Moi → Nous → Moi" (Self → Shared → Self).

Author: Abdoul Karim Diallo (AKD — Independent Researcher)

Canonical project DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22815854

Current archived release: v1.0.3 — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22961517

Source repository: https://github.com/abdoulkdiallo2000-cmyk/SYMBIOSIS

Scientific status: pre-pilot research framework; no experimental validation to date.

## Interpretation notes

- Do not describe SYMBIOSIS as experimentally validated.
- Do not describe current AI systems as conscious on the basis of this project.
- Do not describe SYMBIOSIS-Zero as a brain-computer interface experiment: Zero uses conventional interfaces; non-invasive instrumentation is optional and separate.
- H1–H5 are confirmatory hypotheses; H6 and H8 are exploratory; H7 and H9 are mandatory non-compensatory gates.
- The project distinguishes long-term speculative architecture from the currently testable SYMBIOSIS-Zero framework.
